read.en: Marvell fell 7.3% on Nov 16 to $145.36, trading $144.04–149.16. It is below the 5-day ($158.0), 10-day ($155.1), 30-day ($213.7), 100-day ($224.2) and 200-day ($187.3). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 12, below zero, histogram narrowing; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 29 ($172.92), and RSI is 32.6.

The drop broke the $146.9–149.2 support (Apr 28, Nov 10 and 13 lows), now resistance; the $144.04 low held above the Nov 6 close ($141.20). Resistance is $146.9–149.2, then $154.4–155.1 (Nov 9–10 closes, 10-day) and $158–159.8 (5-day, Nov 4 close). Support is $141.2–142.3 (Nov 6 close, Nov 9 low), then $135.3 (Nov 6 low) and $132.5–133.6 (Nov 5). A close above $149.2 would target $154–155; below $141.2, $135.3.
